dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Wáng Míng, túshūguǎn jǐ diǎn kāimén?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 早上八点开门，晚上九点关门。
dialogue.reading: Zǎoshang bā diǎn kāimén, wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn guānmén.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Xiànzài bā diǎn bàn, mén hái méi kāi!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Nà wǒmen xiān qù chī zǎofàn ba.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Hǎo! Shítáng qī diǎn jiù kāimén.
